summary: Skool stores post, comment and lesson bodies as a TipTap document serialized into a JSON string, so any command that writes a body needs a markdown converter rather than a free-text field.
reason: The spec and the generated help both advertised a --md flag for converting markdown, but no such flag and no converter existed; the only way to post was to hand-write TipTap nodes, which Skool rejects without saying which block was wrong. The converter covers exactly the subset Skool's own editor round-trips, headings included only to level 3.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/tiptap covers every node and mark in the subset plus the H1/H2 clamp, unclosed delimiters and escapes; posts create --md --dry-run emits the expected document.
